ND Iſrael taking hie iourney with al things that he
had came to the wel of the oath, and killing there
victimes to the God of his father Iſaac, 2. he heard
him by. a viſion of the night calling him, and ſaying
vnto him: Iacob, Iacob. To whom he anſwered: Loe
here I am. 2. God ſaid to him: I am the moſt Mightie
God of thy father: feare not, goe downe into AEgypt, tor into a great
nation wil I make thee there. 4. I wil goe downe with thee thither, and
thence wil I bring thee returning: Ioſeph alſo ſnal put his handes vpon
thine eyes. 5. And Iacob roſe vp from the wel of the oath : and his
ſonnes tooke him vp, with their little ones and wiues in the Waynes,
which Pharao had ſent to carie the old man, c. and al that he had poſ-
ſeſſed in the Land ot Chanaan: and he came into AEgypt with al his
ſeed, 7. his ſounes , and nephewes, daughters, and al his progenie
together. &. And theſe are the names of the children of Iſrael, that en-
tred into AEgypt, himſelte with his children. His ſirſt-begotten Ruben.
.The ſonnes of Ruben : Henoch and Phallu and Heſron and Charmi.
†0. The ſones ot Simeon : Iamuel and Iamnin and Ahod, and lachin
and Sohat, and Saul the ſonne of Chananiteſfe. 11. The ſonnes of Leui:
Gerſon and Caath and Merati. 12. The ſonnes of Iuda : Her & Onan
and Sela and Phares and Lara. And Her and Onan died in the land of
Chanaan. And there were ſonnes borne to Phares : Heſron and Hanuil.
12. The ſonnes of Iſſachar: Thola and Phua and Iob and Semron. 14,
The ſonnes of Tabulon : Sared and Elon and Iahelel. 15. Theſe are the
ſonnes of Lia, which ſhe bare (a) in Meſopotamia of Svria with Dina
his daughter. Al the ſoules of his ſonnes and daughters are thirtie
three. 16. The ſonnes of Gad : Sephion and Haggi and Siuni & Eſebon
and Heri and Arodi and Areli. 17. The ſonnes of Aſet : Iamne and
Ieſua and Ieſſui and Beria, Sata alſo theit ſiſter. The ſonnee of Beria :
Heber and Melchiel, 18. theſe be the ſonnes of Telpha, whom Laban
gaue to Lia his daughter. and theſe ſhe bare to Iacob iixteen ſoules.
10. The ſonnes of Rachel Iacobs wife : Ioſeph and Beniamin. 20. And
there were ſonnes borne to Ioſeph in the Land of AEgypt, wnich
Aſeneth the daughter ot Putiphar Prieſt of Hcliopolis bare to him:
Manaſſes aud Ephraim. 21. The ſonnes of Beniamin: Bela and Be-
